prompt: Hibernate Envers @NotFound IGNORE side effect to-one
answer:
`@NotFound(action = NotFoundAction.IGNORE)` has this side effect: it makes a to-one association implicitly eager, even if mapped with `FetchType.LAZY`.

It suppresses the missing-target exception and sets the association to `null` when the foreign-key value has no corresponding row. Hibernate eagerly fetches the association to verify whether the referenced row exists.

This applies to `@ManyToOne` and `@OneToOne` associations. ([Hibernate Envers documentation](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/5.0/userguide/en-US/html/ch18.html), [Hibernate `@NotFound` Javadocs](https://docs.hibernate.org/orm/7.2/javadocs/org/hibernate/annotations/NotFound.html))
